## Outcome

What changes for a user, operator, researcher, or contributor?

## Rationale

Why is this the smallest useful change?

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `npm audit --audit-level=high`
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Interface changes checked at desktop and mobile widths
- [ ] Keyboard and reduced-motion behavior checked

## Boundaries

- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, or personal data are included
- [ ] Generated salience is not described as evidence
- [ ] Provider, retention, logging, and model-cost implications are documented
- [ ] User-facing behavior and README/docs are updated

Commands, results, screenshots, benchmarks, or evaluation notes:
